title:
Viewing this weekend?
*Set your walk-away price*

lines.say: You're viewing a condo this weekend. Before you go, set your walk-away price.
Start with what the bank will lend, and what you can pay without touching your emergency buffer.
Then check recent sales of similar units in the same project.
Write down one number. That's the most you'll pay.
At the viewing, the pressure feels real: other buyers, a deadline, a last unit.
With your number already set, you decide calmly.
Save this before your next viewing.

caption:
